title: fix(limits): rate limits count per organisation, not per key
body: Limits were counted per API key, which is wrong: an organisation with two keys got twice the quota. This counts usage per organisation so that every key of a team shares one limit, and REST, GraphQL and batch ingest now ask the same limiter. A migration carries existing usage over instead of resetting it. Under load, latency now goes from 4.0 to 4.2 ms.
author: acme-dev

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+UPDATE usage_counters SET subject = 'org:' || org_id WHERE subject LIKE 'key:%';
files.headContent: UPDATE usage_counters SET subject = 'org:' || org_id WHERE subject LIKE 'key:%';
